Ltd. is hiring a motivated Chartered Accountant (CA) to join its team in Pune! 📌 Key Responsibilities: Manage accounting and financial records; handle GST, TDS and other statutory compliances; prepare and review financial statements; bank reconciliation and financial reporting; assist with audits and taxation matters; monitor accounts payable and receivable; support management with financial analysis. 🎯 Freshers (CA) are welcome to apply; 1–2 years of relevant experience preferred. Strong accounting & taxation knowledge, analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel required. 📍 109, Suratwala Mark Plazo, Hinjewadi, Pune – 411057. 📧 Apply: info@padmayog.in | 📞 +91 788 766 2700

Company Description
Finforeca is a finance technology and services company focused on simplifying financial decision-making through Enterprise Finance AI and curated Finance Shared Services. The organization supports finance teams with strategic solutions such as Fractional CFO, FP&A, F&A, M&A, and Finance Business Partnering, backed by modern digital capabilities. A key offering is its Corporate Cash Flow Planning Platform, designed to improve clarity, agility, and forecasting for corporate liquidity. Finforeca’s mission is to revolutionize enterprise finance with technology-led solutions that align strategy, enhance visibility, and strengthen financial operations. With global, cross-industry experience, the company enables clients to modernize finance functions, improve cash planning, and drive data-informed decisions.

Role Description
The Finance Shared Services Specialist is a full-time remote role that supports core finance and accounting operations within Finforeca's shared services model: processing and reconciling financial transactions, maintaining accurate accounting records, and preparing and reviewing financial statements for US clients.
You will own the day-to-day books and month-end close for a portfolio of multiple US clients. That means the accounting is accurate, on time, US GAAP compliant and documented well enough that a fractional CFO, an auditor or an investor can rely on it without re-performing it. You will work inside each client's own accounting stack (mostly NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero and Acumatica), follow Finforeca's close checklists and controls, and escalate judgement calls to the CFO with a recommended answer rather than an open question. Day to day, this also means validating data in finance systems, supporting month-end and year-end close, responding to finance-related queries, documenting procedures, adhering to compliance standards, and using digital tools to improve efficiency and visibility across finance operations.

What you will do
Accounts payable and receivable: process vendor bills, approvals and payment runs in whichever AP workflow and accounting system the client uses; issue invoices, apply cash and run collections; maintain vendor and customer masters; track DSO, DPO and CEI.
Month-end close: bank and credit card reconciliations, accruals and prepaids, fixed assets and depreciation, intercompany, payroll journals and balance sheet reconciliations with supporting schedules; deliver the close package within the agreed number of business days.
Technical accounting schedules: revenue recognition (ASC 606), deferred contract costs (ASC 340-40), fixed assets (ASC 360) and inventory (ASC 330) where a client's business requires them, following the policy set by the CFO.
Cash, payroll and compliance: maintain the weekly cash position for the 13-week cash forecast; support US payroll processing on the client's payroll platform; prepare schedules for indirect tax filings, information returns, audits and tax return preparation by the client's external accountants.
Process and controls: document procedures for every recurring task; validate data flowing into client finance systems; respond to finance queries from client teams; support system implementations, module rollouts and migrations; identify automation opportunities and work with Finforeca's AI-assisted delivery tooling as it is introduced.

What you bring
4 to 7 years in accounting or finance operations, with at least 2 years on US client books in a KPO, outsourced accounting firm, shared services centre or US-headquartered company from India.
Hands-on experience in at least two of NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero and Acumatica; Sage Intacct, Ramp.com or Bill.com experience is a plus.
Working knowledge of US GAAP: accruals, revenue recognition basics, fixed assets, prepaids and deferrals.
Strong Excel: lookups, pivots, reconciliations that tie out, clean schedules that someone else can follow.
B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA or ACCA (or equivalent); a completed CA or CPA is welcome but not required.
Clear written English, comfortable on video calls with US clients, and a habit of closing loops and documenting as you go.
Experience using AI tools to build financial statements, schedules, reconciliations and analysis in Excel or Google Sheets, and to produce related presentations or browser-based visualizations, is a plus.
Able to work an India-day schedule that extends to 10 to 11 PM IST on most days to overlap with US mornings.

What we offer
Competitive compensation: fixed CTC plus an annual performance bonus.
Fully remote, anywhere in India. Company-provided laptop, health insurance, PF and gratuity.
Direct exposure to US finance: CFO-level review, multiple industries and accounting stacks, audits and fundraising cycles.
Small team with direct access to the founder, and a path into Finance Shared Services Lead as the bench grows.

How to apply
Apply through LinkedIn and attach your CV; applications reach our hiring team directly. In your CV or a short cover note, tell us about the US client books you have run: systems used, close timelines you held, and the most complex reconciliation or accounting issue you resolved. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a brief practical exercise before interviews.

data.job_title: Accounting Process & Consolidation Subject Matter Expert
data.job_description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an Accounting Process & Consolidation Subject Matter Expert (SME) with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting processes, financial close, consolidation, and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience across key finance and accounting cycles such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), General Ledger (GL), Intercompany Accounting, Financial Close, Consolidation, and Financial Reporting, along with a working understanding of Internal Audit, ICFR, financial controls, and compliance requirements.

This role is designed for professionals who are interested in working at the intersection of Accounting, Finance Transformation, Controls, Process Improvement, and Technology. The candidate will work closely with clients, product teams, and developers to understand existing finance processes and translate practical accounting requirements into scalable technology-driven solutions.

The role requires a proactive and adaptable individual who is comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment and across multiple areas of accounting, finance, audit, controls, and technology.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Accounting Process Understanding
• Understand and analyze clients' end-to-end accounting and finance processes, including:
• Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
• Order-to-Cash (O2C)
• Record-to-Report (R2R)
• General Ledger Accounting
• Accounts Payable
• Accounts Receivable
• Fixed Assets
• Inventory Accounting
• Bank and Account Reconciliations
• Intercompany Accounting
• Financial Close
• Consolidation
• Financial Reporting
• Understand transaction flows from source documents and sub-ledgers through the General Ledger and ultimately into consolidated financial statements.
• Identify process gaps, accounting issues, manual activities, reconciliation challenges, control weaknesses, and opportunities for automation.

2. Financial Close & Consolidation
• Understand and contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.
• Review and understand entity-level trial balances and consolidation requirements.
• Support processes relating to:
• Trial balance validation
• Period-end journal entries
• Accruals and provisions
• Prepayments
• Account reconciliations
• Intercompany reconciliations
• Intercompany eliminations
• Foreign currency translation
• Consolidation adjustments
• Reclassification entries
• Top-side adjustments
• Consolidation of subsidiaries and reporting entities
• Preparation and review of consolidated financial statements
• Understand dependencies between operational accounting processes and the financial close and consolidation process.

3. Accounting & Financial Reporting
• Apply practical knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting requirements while designing accounting solutions.
• Understand accounting treatment and reporting implications of transactions across different finance processes.
• Analyze the impact of accounting transactions on the Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and related financial reporting.
• Support the design of accounting rules, journal-entry logic, reconciliation logic, and reporting requirements within finance technology solutions.
• Contribute to solutions involving automated accounting, financial close, consolidation, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

4. Finance Process Transformation & Documentation
• Understand clients' As-Is finance and accounting processes and identify opportunities for standardization, optimization, and automation.
• Design and document To-Be processes incorporating accounting requirements, controls, automation, and technology.
• Prepare detailed:
• Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
• Functional Requirement Documents
• Process Flow Diagrams
• Accounting Workflows
• User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
• Business Rules
• Accounting Rules and Validation Logic
• Reconciliation and Exception-Handling Workflows
• Translate practical finance and accounting requirements into clear functional requirements for product and development teams.

5. Audit, ICFR & Controls
• Apply a working understanding of Internal Audit, ICFR, financial controls, and risk assessment while designing accounting processes and solutions.
• Identify key financial reporting risks and relevant controls within processes such as P2P, O2C, R2R, financial close, and consolidation.
• Understand concepts including:
• Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs)
• Process-Level Controls
• Entity-Level Controls
• Preventive and Detective Controls
• Manual and Automated Controls
• Segregation of Duties
• Management Review Controls
• Reconciliation Controls
• IT-Dependent Controls
• Support the design of accounting solutions that maintain appropriate audit trails, approvals, evidence, access controls, and financial reporting controls.
• Collaborate with audit and compliance teams where accounting processes or product functionality impact ICFR or financial reporting controls.

6. Product & Technology Collaboration
• Act as a bridge between Accounting/Finance teams and Product/Technology teams.
• Translate complex accounting and finance requirements into functional requirements that can be understood and implemented by developers.
• Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and client stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
• Contribute accounting expertise to the design of AI-driven and automation-based finance solutions.
• Participate in solution design discussions and validate whether proposed functionality appropriately addresses accounting and business requirements.

7. Product Testing & UAT
• Develop accounting and business scenarios for product testing.
• Perform functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of accounting and finance solutions.
• Validate:
• Accounting calculations
• Journal entries
• Posting logic
• Reconciliation logic
• Matching logic
• Exception handling
• Approval workflows
• Consolidation logic
• Financial reporting outputs
• Identify functional gaps and work with development teams to resolve issues before deployment.

8. Client Implementation & Support
• Participate in client discussions to understand existing finance processes, systems, accounting requirements, and pain points.
• Support deployment and implementation of accounting and finance solutions within client environments.
• Assist with process mapping, configuration requirements, testing, data validation, and implementation.
• Provide user training and functional guidance to finance and accounting teams.
• Support post-deployment activities and identify opportunities for continuous process and product improvement.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications
• Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred.
• MBA Finance, CMA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent finance/accounting qualifications may also be considered depending on relevant experience.
• Additional certifications in Finance Transformation, ERP, Internal Audit, CISA, or related areas are an advantage.
• Big 4, consulting, shared services, Global Capability Center (GCC), or large corporate finance experience is preferred.

Experience
• 4+ years of hands-on experience in Accounting, Financial Reporting, Financial Close, Consolidation, Finance Transformation, or related finance functions.
• Practical exposure to one or more end-to-end finance processes such as:
• P2P
• O2C
• R2R
• General Ledger
• Intercompany Accounting
• Financial Close
• Consolidation
• Financial Reporting
• Experience in month-end, quarter-end, and/or year-end close activities is preferred.
• Exposure to Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, ICFR/SOX, or financial controls is an added advantage.
• Experience working with finance technology, ERP systems, automation, or finance transformation projects is preferred.

Skills Required

Accounting & Finance
• Strong understanding of double-entry accounting, General Ledger, Trial Balance, and financial statements.
• Strong understanding of end-to-end accounting cycles and their impact on financial reporting.
• Practical knowledge of financial close, account reconciliations, intercompany accounting, consolidation, and reporting.
• Understanding of accounting standards such as Ind AS, IFRS, and/or US GAAP is preferred.

Process Knowledge
• Ability to understand and document complete finance processes from transaction initiation through accounting, reconciliation, close, consolidation, and reporting.
• Ability to identify process inefficiencies, accounting risks, control gaps, and automation opportunities.
• Experience creating As-Is and To-Be process flows and detailed accounting workflows.

Audit & Controls
• Working knowledge of Internal Audit, ICFR/SOX, risk assessment, financial controls, and control testing.
• Ability to understand how accounting processes, controls, and system functionality collectively support reliable financial reporting.

Technology & Transformation
• Experience preparing BRDs, functional requirements, process documentation, user stories, workflows, and UAT scenarios.
• Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday, or similar platforms is preferred.
• Exposure to financial close, consolidation, reconciliation, workflow automation, RPA, analytics, or AI-based finance solutions is an advantage.
• Ability to translate accounting requirements into clear functional requirements for technology teams.

Analytical & Stakeholder Management
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to analyze complex accounting and process scenarios and convert them into structured solutions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to communicate effectively with CFO teams, Controllers, Finance Managers, Accountants, Auditors, Product Managers, and Developers.
• Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

Startup & Innovation Mindset
• Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment with evolving responsibilities.
• Willingness to work across accounting, audit, controls, finance transformation, product development, testing, and implementation activities.
• Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive requirements from business problem identification through solution design, testing, and implementation.
• Interest in leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to transform traditional finance and accounting processes.
